main_text.title: CE-Replay physical-design pipeline
main_text.intended_visual_encoding: Left-to-right pipeline: native semantics and workload/payload inputs; executable specialization; objective and dependency outputs; search; deployment; fresh native validation. Mark offline payload acquisition and fresh realization separately.
main_text.claim_supported: CE-Replay is a design-parametric objective evaluator and dependency oracle, not the search algorithm or an automatic source compiler.

main_text.title: Cross-workload non-monotonicity of statistics-set inclusion
main_text.intended_visual_encoding: Two panels. Within each workload show empty, all-statistics, and selected-subset outcomes on a workload-local scale; annotate harmful singleton and improving-removal counts. Preserve raw values in accompanying text/table and do not compare y magnitudes across panels.
main_text.claim_supported: Selection remains meaningful independently of a binding budget.

main_text.title: Mechanism-aware recurring ANALYZE cost
main_text.intended_visual_encoding: Census and DMV panels; x-axis deployed object count/composition, y-axis aggregate ANALYZE latency; separate MCV and FD observations/fits; report coefficients and fit quality per panel.
main_text.claim_supported: A mechanism-aware object-count model is a useful first-order maintenance proxy, with environment-specific coefficients.

main_text.title: Directed MCV-to-FD composition
main_text.intended_visual_encoding: State-transition diagram from MCV applicability through GreedyCover/clause consumption to FD applicability, paired with a compact all-statistics versus optimized-subset FD-consumption comparison for both workloads.
main_text.claim_supported: MCV consumption changes downstream FD reachability, requiring compositional optimization.

main_text.title: Complementary workload and candidate structure
main_text.intended_visual_encoding: Columns for queries, rows, predicate columns/forms, structural pairs, usable mechanism candidates, candidate degree, incidence character, and major semantic feature.
main_text.claim_supported: DMV is meaningful structural replication but not a Census-scale candidate-space benchmark.

main_text.title: Native semantic fidelity within the supported fragment
main_text.intended_visual_encoding: Rows for Census MCV, FD fixtures, ScalarArray fixtures/regression, real DMV frozen comparisons, and both fresh deployments; columns for semantic fragment, comparisons, tolerance passes, and maximum relative error.
main_text.claim_supported: Replay matches native estimates at reported floating-point tolerances inside an explicit boundary.

main_text.title: Maintenance-budget physical-design outcomes
main_text.intended_visual_encoding: Per workload: budget, usable universe, selected MCV/FD, modeled cost, unused capacity, objective, consumed objects, terminal audit, and exhaustive-audit scope.
main_text.claim_supported: Replay drives resource-constrained design; workload-scale guarantees are neighborhood-local, while small/restricted instances have exhaustive evidence.

main_text.title: Exact incremental evaluation under sparse and dense incidence
main_text.intended_visual_encoding: Rows for Census MCV, Census mixed, and DMV mixed; columns for degree/topology, evaluated neighborhood, trajectory agreement, replay/control-work reduction, and wall-clock result.
main_text.claim_supported: Semantic dependency information reduces audited control work without a universal runtime guarantee.

main_text.title: Physical deployment and fresh native validation
main_text.intended_visual_encoding: Rows Census/DMV; columns selected design, order verification, fresh ANALYZE, materialization/consumption, frozen prediction, fresh replay/native, maximum semantic error, paired drift availability, and cost-model prediction error. DMV paired drift cell explicitly says unavailable due to missing frozen per-query provenance.
main_text.claim_supported: Both designs physically realize and validate fresh semantics; only Census supports complete paired numerical drift analysis.

appendix.claim_supported: Payload drift is distinct from semantic replay error.

appendix.intended_visual_encoding: Persisted versus missing state and supported versus blocked claims.
appendix.claim_supported: The DMV limitation is provenance incompleteness, not fresh semantic failure.
